title: Go and see
goal: Link two actions of the same person with -(y)Ip: gidip aldım, oturup konuşalım, okula gitmeyip evde kaldı.

intro.text: `-(y)Ip` joins two actions of one person. The first verb takes `-Ip`, the last one takes the tense and the person: *Markete gidip ekmek aldım* (I went to the shop and bought bread), *Oturup konuşalım* (Let's sit down and talk).

vocab.en: to withdraw money, to take out money
to go back and forth; to commute

exercises.question: How do you say **I went and bought bread**?

why.1: `-Ip` goes on the bare stem, with no tense: *git-* + *-ip*.
why.2: The last verb carries the tense and the person: *aldım*.
why.3: *Git-* softens before a vowel: *gidip*, as in *gidiyor*.

exercises.explain: *gid-ip* has no tense; *aldım* gives the past and **I** to both actions.

exercises.en: Let's sit down and talk a little.

reject.why: The buffer y comes only after a vowel; *otur-* ends in r: *oturup*.

exercises.label: *gidip bakmak* (to go and look) in the past: I went and looked, you went and looked…
exercises.explain: *Gidip* never changes; only the last verb takes the past and the person: *baktım, baktın, baktı…*

exercises.prompt: I went to the bank and withdrew money.
accept: Ben bankaya [gidip para çektim|gittim ve para çektim].
I'll send the parcel right away and call you.
I'll send the package right away and call you.
I'll send the [parcel|package] immediately and call you.
I'll send the [parcel|package] (right away|immediately) and then call you.

exercises.en: I came home and went straight to bed.

exercises.gloss: reading, and then doing something else
exercises.explain: *oku-* ends in a vowel, so y comes first; after u, four-way harmony gives *-up*: *okuyup*.

exercises.prompt: Let's sit down and have a tea.

exercises.question: *Okula gitmeyip evde kaldı.* What did she do?
options: She stayed at home instead of going to school.
She went to school and then stayed at home.
She didn't go home or to school.

why.1: *Gitmeyip* is negative: she **didn't** go to school.

exercises.explain: `-mAyIp` negates its own verb only: **not going** to school, she stayed at home.

exercises.en: Ali commutes to Ankara every day.
exercises.explain: *gidip gelmek*: to go and come back, to commute. The tense is on *geliyor*.

exercises.en: I waited in line and withdrew money.

accept: She got up and opened the window.
He got up and opened the window.
[He|She] stood up and opened the window.
